$comment: The body-type client patch. NOT PUBLISHED: it is deliberately absent from
launcher/patch-manifest.json, so no launcher applies it.
Skirmisher is class 3 (Hunter), not 7 (Shaman). Paladin x Hunter x Mage is
the only chassis triple in which every playable race has at least one body
type — Night Elf has none under Paladin/Shaman/Mage. Approved; the
reasoning and the other five combinations are in ADR 0010 §10.
`add` is the thirteen race/body-type pairs the client blocks and the server
will accept. Race ids: 1 Human, 2 Orc, 3 Dwarf, 4 Night Elf, 5 Undead,
6 Tauren, 7 Gnome, 8 Troll, 10 Blood Elf, 11 Draenei. Blood Elf and Draenei
need nothing: they can already reach all three.
name_field is 4, not 5. The core's own loader says so: ChrClassesEntryfmt
in src/server/shared/DataStores/DBCfmt.h at the pinned commit is 60 fields
reading `nxix` then sixteen `s` — id at 0, powerType at 2, PetNameToken at
3, and Name_Lang at 4..19 with its flags word at 20. This said 5 until
2026-09-03, which would have written the name one column late, left the
enUS name untouched and overwritten the flags word. The struct comment in
DBCStructure.h says 5-20 and is wrong; the format string is what parses.
CONFIRMED against a real 3.3.5a client on 2026-09-03. The client reports 60
fields at 240 bytes with Name_Lang at field 4 (flags 16712191), 62
CharBaseInfo rows, and 17 of the 30 race/body-type pairs already present —
so these thirteen are its exact complement, checked pair by pair. The
server-side race data is applied and verified live.
Still absent from patch-manifest.json, and no longer because of the data:
nothing reads that file yet. The launcher runtime does not fetch, build,
verify or apply a recipe — launcher_core::recipe is a tested library that
main.rs never calls — so listing it here would change nothing except to
make the repository claim otherwise. The work that remains is enumerated
in ADR 0009 §6.
summary: Shows the three Ashmorrow body types at character creation instead of ten stock classes.
